slides.title:
DAYS LEFT
IN 2026
slides.sub: This is one of the last 6 Mondays.

slides.text: “I'll start next Monday” costs you a full week. Every time.
slides.sub: 6 more of those and 2026 is gone.

slides.text: Pick one habit. Make it small enough to do today.
Give it a time. “After lunch,” not “sometime.”
Do it, then mark day 1. Tonight.
“Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.”
slides.sub: Today is the one you have.

slides.title:
START TODAY.
NOT NEXT MONDAY.

slides.title: YOUR WEAKEST STAT IS DRAGGING THE REST DOWN

slides.text: Bad sleep kills your workout. A tired body skips prayer.
slides.sub: One low stat pulls on every other one.

slides.text: Did you open the Word this week?
Did you move, sleep and eat on purpose?
Did you learn anything, or just scroll?
Do you know where last week's money went?
Who did you call, help or encourage?
Lowest number gets one daily quest. Just one.
slides.sub: Raise the floor, not the ceiling.

slides.title:
FIND IT TODAY.
FIX IT THIS WEEK.

posts.hook:
YOUR MIND IS
YOUR HIGHEST STAT.
STOP DRAINING IT.

slides.text: December spending hits harder when you never checked November.
slides.sub: You can't fix what you don't see.

slides.text: Open your bank app. Read the last 30 days.
List every subscription. Cancel one you forgot.
Write down every purchase the same day.
Pick one leak. Set a limit for December.
“Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.”

scenes.cap: STOP RUSHING OUT THE DOOR WITHOUT PRAYING.

slides.title: DO THIS 7-DAY RESET BEFORE DECEMBER HITS

slides.text: Most people drift into December and promise January.
slides.sub: Reset now and you start December strong.

slides.text: Clean your room. Clear your desk. Wash the car.
Bed by 11. Walk every day. Water before coffee.
Delete one app that drains you. Check your bank.
Pray over December. Write 3 goals for it.
“…his compassions fail not. They are new every morning…”
